mentions.name: Automotion
mentions.description: Web tool that turns screenshots into UI animations instantly, built to address the poor UI quality that AI coding assistants produce.
mentions.problem: AI coding assistants produce working code but poor UI: identical beige SaaS dashboards, no visual hierarchy, inconsistent design systems, and bouncy, noisy micro-interactions unrelated to the user's task, and asking models to refine designs bulldozes the good parts instead of making small surgical tweaks.
mentions.audience: The author's own use as a developer building front-ends ("I'm my own user")
mentions.source_excerpt: Built out http://automotion.dev to solve this, it turns screenshots into UI animations instantly. Been a game-changer for me and I'm my own user.
